title: DOH, FAMILY HUI HAWAIʻI TO HOST FAMILY WELLNESS DAY AT STATE CAPITOL
summary: HONOLULU — The Hawaiʻi Department of Health (DOH) Children with Special Health Needs Branch (CSHNB), in partnership with Family Hui Hawaiʻi, will host a Family Wellness Day on Thursday, Oct. 8, from 9:30 a.m. to noon at the Hawaiʻi State Capitol Rotunda (ʻEwa side). The event aligns with the state’s annual Children and Youth Month, […]
